not_golden.why: covered by financial_gold (Codex public-financial-gold/1 snapshot, same cutoff).
Judgment module: model-owned analytical block; no source-fixed answer.
Judgment module: narrative and conclusions; the checkable inputs it needs are the CP-1B, CP-1D and debt facts above.

needs_user_input.why: Market cap, net debt, EV and share price are market data, not in the filings. Not needed for earnings_update; left empty.
Agency ratings are not in the corpus. Left empty.
No observed or indicative quotes in the corpus. Left empty.
The 10-Q names the Company as guarantor and describes the others only by class; the subsidiary list (10-K Exhibit 22 if any) was not extracted. Only the parent is listed.

No management bridge was supplied, so the form marks CP-1D management-bridge cells not applicable. The golden CP-1D facts are the company's own net income to Adjusted EBITDA reconciliation printed in the 10-Q.
FY2025 guidance is not in the corpus (recorded as a missing fact). The user would need to supply the earnings release.

limitations: Scale: the 10-Q prints P&L and debt-table amounts in USD thousands, but the checker enum allows only millions|units. Those values are stored as exact decimal millions (printed thousands / 1000, lossless, e.g. 294,341 -> 294.341, same convention as Codex financial_gold); evidence.printed keeps the thousands text. Amounts printed in millions stay millions; the Amendment No. 4 amount is printed in dollars (scale units).

Prior period is the same quarter a year earlier (three months ended 2024-06-30), the side-by-side comparison the 10-Q prints. The Codex cp1b_delta_inputs.json instead uses Q1 2025 vs Q2 2025 (sequential); that pair is not covered here.

The brief dates Amendment No. 4 at 2024-08-05; that is the filing date of the 10-Q carrying it as Exhibit 10.1. The amendment is dated 2024-05-30 (effective date) and the 8-K closing release is dated 2024-05-30.

The Term loan due 2031 row in Note 8 is the Refinancing Term Loans created by Amendment No. 4 (original principal $1,509,350,000); 1,498,030 is the 2025-06-30 gross principal after scheduled amortisation.

Revolver total commitments of $600.0 million come from Amendment No. 5 (2025-04-30), which postdates Amendment No. 4; the 10-Q text does not print drawn capacity separately, only that no borrowings were outstanding.
A dash printed for Illinois EO litigation settlements in Q2 2024 is recorded as value 0 (printed "—").
Net income to Adjusted EBITDA reconciliation is the registrant's own (Adjusted Net Income path); consolidated Adjusted EBITDA equals total segment income as printed in Note 16.
